segments.comment: Valid independent selected-location recipe for pager.c do_look. The two spaces acknowledge the startup and cursor prompt boundaries, and . selects the blind hero square. C reaches its nonstopping putmixed(WIN_MESSAGE) output with the map cursor restored; JS reaches the description through ttyPutmixed but leaves a stopping --More-- marker and the top-line cursor. Keep unrecorded until the existing tty_message.js ttyPutmixed/windows.c putmixed owner is corrected.
